checks.name: CPython embedded Expat declares 2.8.5
checks.detail: Measured pyexpat version and pinned source header agree.

checks.name: ParseBuffer capacity guard absent in pinned source
checks.detail: Upstream fix 13c5f63 adds this check; wrapper bounds do not repair native implementation.

checks.name: pyexpat Parse chunk bound
checks.detail: Both full chunks and final remainder pass bounded lengths to XML_Parse.

checks.name: ParseFile requests fresh fixed buffer
checks.detail: Each iteration allocates buffer before XML_ParseBuffer.

checks.name: ParseFile read size guarded
checks.detail: readinst rejects oversized bytes/bytearray before copy; no huge buffers executed.

checks.name: ElementTree calls XML_Parse API
checks.detail: C API pointer resolves to XML_Parse, not direct XML_ParseBuffer.

checks.name: ElementTree has signed-int bounds
checks.detail: feed unicode, buffer and parse_whole bytes paths check length before cast.

checks.name: All observed ELF files 64-bit
checks.detail: CVE-2026-102633 CNA requires 32-bit; architecture excludes that stated condition in this image only.

cve_77214.standard_binding_paths: Parse uses XML_Parse; ParseFile fresh GetBuffer(2048) plus read-size guard; ElementTree XML_Parse with INT_MAX guard. These checks constrain the caller length for inspected paths.
cve_77214.unproven: External C API consumers, ctypes/direct exports and application reachability not exhausted. No exploit, huge allocation or crash attempted.
cve_77214.candidate_remedy: Verified CPython base with Expat 2.9.0 or capacity backport; apt libexpat does not replace embedded source.
